summary: OpenAI's Mark Chen announced the launch of GPT-6 Astra, a new flagship model described as capable of building and testing software and working across apps on a user's computer.

mechanisms.reason: The post announces a new flagship model family with expanded agentic capabilities (software building/testing, cross-app computer use), framed as the lab's most capable model to date, though no benchmark figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-6 Astra is here! This is a big moment for our research team - years of work on pretraining, reinforcement learning, and post-training have come together in our most capable and aligned model yet.

mechanisms.reason: The model is described as able to act across applications and build/test software autonomously, suggesting agentic tool use, but no scale or metrics are given.
